# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 95 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 95 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_095_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 12

**1** "Now I want to explain to you the stones that were taken up from the deep and placed into the building fitted together with the stones that had already been built," he said. **2** "The first — the ten stones — are the first generation; the second — the twenty-five — are the second generation of righteous men; **3** the third — the thirty-five — are prophets of God and his ministers; the fourth — the forty — are apostles and teachers of the proclamation of the Son of God." **4** "But why did the virgins also carry the stones through the gate and give them to build the tower?" **5** "Because these were the first to bear these spirits, and they did not separate from one another — neither the spirits from the men nor the men from the spirits — but the spirits remained with them until they fell asleep. **6** And if the spirits had not been with them, they could not have been useful for the building of the tower." **7** "Now explain to me what the tower is," I said. **8** "The tower," he answered, "as I said before, is the church." **9** "But those who were rejected — who are they?" **10** "These are those who sinned and wish to repent. On this account they were not cast far from the tower, because they will be useful for the building if they repent. **11** Those therefore who are going to repent, if they repent, will be strong in faith — that is, if they repent now, while the tower is being built. **12** But if the tower is finished, they will no longer have a place in it, but will be castoffs. And this privilege — of being near the tower — is theirs because of affliction; they must be afflicted, for they are not being afflicted without purpose."

---

*EMET: the four generations of stones (10+25+35+40) = patriarchs → righteous → prophets → apostles. The historical sweep of salvation history is built into the tower's foundation.*
